scope: source inspection only; causal WAN bottleneck not proven

observations.behavior: Each changed publication encodes a complete durable snapshot and writes an independent recovery witness before the primary checkpoint.
Witness JSON embeds the complete snapshot plus archive and previous/next tokens.
Primary synchronous atomic CAS WriteBatch writes the complete checkpoint payload, metadata and execution suffix.
Clock uses tick_if_needed; publication is already coalesced by consensus phase rather than unconditional every poll.

notClaimed: Snapshot serialization alone proves the WAN cause
WAL or synchronous write durability can be disabled safely
nextEvidence: After authoritative terminal stop, correlate durable sequence change, checkpoint payload size and actual recovery with send latency and accumulated BlockIO.
